# Xiaofeiyu (小肥鱼) — Complete Technical & Hardware Reference (`llms-full.txt`)

## 1. What Problem Does Xiaofeiyu Solve? / 小肥鱼解决什么核心痛点？

Open-source roleplay and companion LLMs traditionally force an unpleasant trade-off:
1. **Prompt-only roleplay** produces "AI slop": 50-word customer-service paragraphs, theatrical stage brackets (`（气鼓鼓）`, `*sighs*`), emoji walls, and repetitive nanny clichés (`多喝热水`, `早点休息`).
2. **Full-sequence SFT/DPO fine-tuning** overwrites reasoning and coding weights ("roleplay lobotomy"), breaking multi-step math, SQL/Python generation, and multi-turn recall.

**Xiaofeiyu (`niatheelf777/xiaofeiyu`) eliminates both failure modes via Split-Phase Brain–Voice Decoupling on Google Gemma 4 (`niatheelf777/xiaofeiyu-12b-v4`):**
- **Phase A — Brain (`LoRA = 0.0`)**: Native `<|channel>thought` reasoning, `calc_python` sandboxed calculation, and `send_code_or_doc` fenced code/tables run on the untouched base Gemma 4 weights, preserving `5/5` engineering & algorithm accuracy (`GEN1..5`).
- **Phase B — Voice (`LoRA = [w0, w1, w2, w3, w4]`)**: As soon as the model enters `call:send_message{bubbles:[<|"|>`, `llama-server` activates five preloaded `.gguf` LoRA cartridges strictly inside the spoken bubble tokens and resets `LoRA = 0.0` at closing `<|"|>`, delivering crisp 1–4 bubble Mandarin IM chat (`0%` stage brackets, `0%` emoji clutter, `0%` prose-in-code-fence smuggling).

---

## 2. Three-Tier Hardware & Quantization Precision Hierarchy

`niatheelf777/xiaofeiyu-12b-v4` is our battle-tested online production model powering `https://xfy.tospeak.top/`. Choose the precision tier that matches your available VRAM:

1. **Tier 1 — #1 Primary Recommendation: High-Precision `Q8_0` (or `BF16`) Base + 5 LoRAs (`≥ 16 GB` VRAM / `24 GB+` Unified Memory)**
   - **Why `Q8_0` / `BF16` First**: Low-bit 4-bit quantization degrades micro-expression nuance, subtext granularity, and delicate push-pull phrasing in Mandarin IM conversation. Running `gemma-4-12B-it-Q8_0.gguf` (or `BF16`) with the 5 `.gguf` LoRA cartridges (`--preset 12b` or `--preset 12b-q8`) matches the exact precision deployed on `xfy.tospeak.top` (`~12.8–13.0 GiB` total VRAM w/ 5 LoRAs + 8k KV).
2. **Tier 2 — Dedicated `12 GB` VRAM Sweet Spot: Custom BF16-Derived `UD-Q4_K_XL-xfy` (`12 GB` GPUs or Heavy-Desktop `16 GB` Windows)**
   - **Why Custom `imatrix`**: Because `12B Q8_0` (`~13 GiB`) does not fit inside a `12 GB` VRAM card (`RTX 3060 12GB`, `RTX 4070 / 4070 SUPER 12GB`), we quantized `gemma-4-12B-it-UD-Q4_K_XL-xfy.gguf` directly from the exact `BF16` `google/gemma-4-12B-it` checkpoint using `llama-imatrix --parse-special` on bilingual Mandarin IM + code + native Gemma 4 tool/thought calibration data (protecting `token_embd`, `attn_v`, `ffn_down`, and edge bubble-boundary layers in `Q6_K`, avoiding the comma-spam collapse seen on drifted `QAT Q4_0` weights).
3. **Tier 3 — `6–8 GB` Small-VRAM Sidecar: Cloud Brain + Local `4B` Voice Translator (`niatheelf777/xiaofeiyu-translator-e4b`)**
   - Keep DeepSeek, Claude, GPT, or Qwen as your upstream reasoning/coding brain and run `gemma-4-E4B-it-Q8_0.gguf` + 5 LoRAs locally (`--preset e4b`, `~5.3 GiB` VRAM, `302 ms` median latency, `0%` code-fence or tool alteration).

| Tier & Target Hardware | Launcher `--preset` | HuggingFace Repo | Base GGUF Filename | Total VRAM (5 LoRAs + 8k KV) | Recommended Hardware |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **1. #1 Primary (`Q8_0` + 5 LoRAs)** | `12b` / `12b-q8` | `ggml-org/gemma-4-12B-it-GGUF` + `niatheelf777/xiaofeiyu-12b-v4` | `gemma-4-12B-it-Q8_0.gguf` | `~12.8–13.0 GiB` | `RTX 4060 Ti 16GB`, `RTX 4070 Ti SUPER`, `RTX 4080 / 4090 / 3090`, Apple Silicon `24GB+` |
| **2. `12 GB` Sweet Spot (Custom `UD-Q4_K_XL-xfy`)** | `12b-q4` | `niatheelf777/xiaofeiyu-12b-v4` | `gemma-4-12B-it-UD-Q4_K_XL-xfy.gguf` (`7.72 GiB`) | `~8.5–8.9 GiB` | `RTX 3060 12GB`, `RTX 4070 / 4070 SUPER 12GB`, heavy-WDDM `16GB` Windows, `16GB` Mac |
| **3. `6–8 GB` Voice Sidecar (`E4B Q8_0`)** | `e4b` | `niatheelf777/xiaofeiyu-translator-e4b` | `gemma-4-E4B-it-Q8_0.gguf` (`4.65 GiB`) | `~5.30 GiB` | `RTX 3060 8GB`, `RTX 4060 8GB`, ultrabooks paired with DeepSeek / Claude / GPT |

---

## 3. 5-Slider Real-Time Persona Mixing (`model="xiaofeiyu-v4|w0,w1,w2,w3,w4"`)

All five `.gguf` LoRA cartridges preload simultaneously via a single comma-separated `--lora` flag with `--lora-init-without-apply`. Every HTTP request can blend personas continuously without reloading weights:

| Slot | File | Label | Persona Voice | Recommended Scale |
| :---: | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `0` | `s0_xiaofeiyu_backbone.gguf` | 元气日常 (Everyday Warmth) | Relaxed everyday Mandarin IM companion rhythm (SFT + On-Policy Anti-Cliché DPO) | `w0 = 1.0` |
| `1` | `c1_neko_clingy.gguf` | 甜系软萌 (Sweet & Clingy) | Affectionate, soft-spoken warmth | `0.0 – 1.0` (`w1+w2+w3+w4 <= 1.15`) |
| `2` | `c2_older_tease.gguf` | 知性姐姐 (Poised Older Sister) | Composed, playful push-pull banter | `0.0 – 1.0` |
| `3` | `c3_brat_mesugaki.gguf` | 傲娇毒舌 (Tsundere Wit) | Sharp-tongued playful banter with underlying care | `0.0 – 1.0` |
| `4` | `c4_fragile_porcelain.gguf` | 安静慢热 (Quiet & Gentle) | Quiet, soft-spoken late-night companionship | `0.0 – 1.0` |

---

## 4. Three Turnkey Integration Postures

### Posture 1: Built-in `:8081` 2D Persona Orb Web UI + OpenAI `/v1` API (Zero Node Dependencies)
```bash
git clone https://github.com/niatheelf777/xiaofeiyu.git && cd xiaofeiyu
pip install tokenizers huggingface_hub

# Primary Recommendation (>= 16GB VRAM / 24GB+ Mac): Q8_0 + 5 LoRAs (~12.9 GiB)
python server/launch_local.py --preset 12b --auto-download-llama --open

# Dedicated 12GB VRAM Sweet Spot (RTX 3060 / 4070 12GB): custom UD-Q4_K_XL-xfy (~8.5-8.9 GiB)
python server/launch_local.py --preset 12b-q4 --auto-download-llama --open
```
Serves the interactive 2D Persona Orb Web UI at `http://127.0.0.1:8081/` and an OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` endpoint at `http://127.0.0.1:8081/v1`.

### Posture 2: DeepSeek Harness (`DSH`) Coding Agent (Dual-Mode)
- **Mode 1 (Zero-Plugin OpenAI Direct)**: Point DSH, Cursor, or OpenWebUI to `http://127.0.0.1:8081/v1` with `model="xiaofeiyu-v4|1.0,0.85,0,0,0"`.
- **Mode 2 (`@xiaofeiyu/dsh-plugin` Native Bubbles + Header Mixer)**:
```bash
node packages/dsh-plugin/scripts/install-dsh.mjs --apply --profile web --upstream-base http://127.0.0.1:8081/v1
# Byte-exact reversible uninstall:
node packages/dsh-plugin/scripts/install-dsh.mjs --uninstall --profile web
```

### Posture 3: `E4B` Universal Voice Proxy (`@xiaofeiyu/openai-voice-proxy`)
Keep DeepSeek, Claude, GPT, or Qwen as your upstream brain while rewriting prose into multi-bubble persona speech locally in `~302 ms` median latency (`0%` code-fence or tool-call alteration):
```bash
python server/launch_local.py --preset e4b --llama-only --auto-download-llama
UPSTREAM_BASE_URL=https://api.deepseek.com/v1 UPSTREAM_API_KEY=your_key TRANSLATOR_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18085 \
  node packages/openai-voice-proxy/bin/xiaofeiyu-voice-proxy.mjs
```

---

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ / 常见问题)

- **Q: Which model and quantization precision should I choose for `16GB+` vs `12GB` vs `8GB` GPUs?**
  **A:** On `≥ 16 GB` GPUs (`RTX 4060 Ti 16GB`, `4080`, `4090`, `3090`) or `24 GB+` Apple Silicon Macs, always choose **`--preset 12b`** (or **`--preset 12b-q8`**) running `gemma-4-12B-it-Q8_0.gguf` + 5 LoRA cartridges (`~12.8–13.0 GiB` VRAM)—the exact precision deployed on `xfy.tospeak.top` with zero 4-bit loss in subtle tone. On `12 GB` GPUs (`RTX 3060 12GB`, `RTX 4070 12GB`) where `Q8_0` cannot fit, use our custom BF16-derived dynamic `imatrix` build **`--preset 12b-q4`** (`gemma-4-12B-it-UD-Q4_K_XL-xfy.gguf`, `~8.5–8.9 GiB` VRAM). On `6–8 GB` GPUs, use **`--preset e4b`** (`~5.3 GiB` VRAM) as a local voice sidecar over DeepSeek / Claude / GPT.
- **Q: Should `<|channel>thought` thinking stay enabled for casual Mandarin IM chat?**
  **A:** Yes. Empirical 3-way A/B/C testing (`Full Thought` vs `Capped 80-tok Thought` vs `Empty Thought`) confirms that keeping native `<|channel>thought` enabled preserves multi-turn callbacks (e.g., remembering earlier stomach pain when asked about iced coffee) and subtle emotional push-pull subtext.
- **Q: Where can I try Xiaofeiyu online before downloading weights?**
  **A:** Visit https://xfy.tospeak.top/ to drag the live 2D Persona Orb and test all five persona sliders in real time, or run [`notebooks/xiaofeiyu_colab_free_t4.ipynb`](https://colab.research.google.com/github/niatheelf777/xiaofeiyu/blob/main/notebooks/xiaofeiyu_colab_free_t4.ipynb) on a free Google Colab T4 (`15 GB`) GPU.
